verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own hosted MCP server exposes inbox, message, thread and calendar tools to any compatible assistant. Its docs also describe relevance-ranked full-text thread search and organization-wide thread retrieval, so an external assistant can retrieve material for grounded answers across AgentMail inboxes. However, AgentMail ships no Q&A assistant of its own, its inboxes are agent-owned rather than the user's existing mailbox, and calendar support is a single mention. Missing for 10: a first-party assistant that answers questions with cited sources, documented calendar querying depth, 'what's outstanding' summarization, coverage of a user's existing personal inbox, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: AgentMail runs a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp` that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools
Full-text search finds Threads by keyword across the sender, recipients, subject, and message body, ranked by relevance.
you can retrieve them in two powerful ways: scoped to a single `Inbox` or across your entire `Organization`.
